numeric_features.name: AMT_INCOME_TOTAL
numeric_features.label: Annual income
numeric_features.meaning: Total declared income of the client

numeric_features.name: AMT_GOODS_PRICE
numeric_features.label: Goods price
numeric_features.meaning: Price of the goods for which the loan is granted

numeric_features.name: AGE_YEARS
numeric_features.label: Age
numeric_features.meaning: Client age in years. This IS the canonical model column; the raw file's DAYS_BIRTH (negative day-count) is converted to it once during ingestion, so training and serving share it.

numeric_features.name: EMPLOYMENT_YEARS
numeric_features.label: Years employed
numeric_features.meaning: Years employed at current job. Canonical model column derived once at ingestion from DAYS_EMPLOYED; the documented 365243 sentinel (pensioners/unemployed) becomes missing with a DAYS_EMPLOYED_MISSING indicator. Omit at serving for pensioners/unemployed -> flag set, value imputed.

numeric_features.name: CNT_CHILDREN
numeric_features.label: Children
numeric_features.meaning: Number of children the client has

numeric_features.name: EXT_SOURCE_1
numeric_features.label: External score 1
numeric_features.meaning: Normalized score from external data source 1

numeric_features.name: EXT_SOURCE_2
numeric_features.label: External score 2
numeric_features.meaning: Normalized score from external data source 2

numeric_features.name: EXT_SOURCE_3
numeric_features.label: External score 3
numeric_features.meaning: Normalized score from external data source 3

numeric_features.name: REGION_POPULATION_RELATIVE
numeric_features.label: Region population (relative)
numeric_features.meaning: Normalized population of the region where the client lives

categorical_features.name: FLAG_OWN_CAR
categorical_features.label: Owns a car
categorical_features.meaning: Whether the client owns a car

categorical_features.name: FLAG_OWN_REALTY
categorical_features.label: Owns real estate
categorical_features.meaning: Whether the client owns real estate

categorical_features.name: OCCUPATION_TYPE
categorical_features.label: Occupation
categorical_features.meaning: Occupation of the client (often missing in real data)

engineered_features.name: CREDIT_INCOME_RATIO
engineered_features.interpretation: Loan size relative to income; higher = more leverage.
engineered_features.leakage_assessment: Safe: both known at application time.

engineered_features.name: ANNUITY_INCOME_RATIO
engineered_features.leakage_assessment: Safe: both known at application time.

engineered_features.name: CREDIT_ANNUITY_RATIO
engineered_features.interpretation: Approximate loan term in payment periods.
engineered_features.leakage_assessment: Safe: both known at application time.

engineered_features.name: CREDIT_GOODS_RATIO
engineered_features.interpretation: Loan vs goods value; >1 implies borrowing beyond price.
engineered_features.leakage_assessment: Safe: both known at application time.

engineered_features.name: EMPLOYMENT_AGE_RATIO
engineered_features.interpretation: Share of life in current employment; stability proxy.

engineered_features.name: EXT_SOURCE_MEAN
engineered_features.leakage_assessment: Safe: external scores are inputs, not outcomes.

engineered_features.name: INCOME_PER_FAM_MEMBER
engineered_features.leakage_assessment: Safe: both known at application time.
